author: Hailer Oy
description: Customer dashboard — assets, support tickets, contacts, opportunities, ManikinPC, rentals, online orders, and trips/IHS visits, all in one place for any client.
versionDescription: Calibration outreach per client: a status dropdown (Not contacted, Contacted waiting, Wants a calibration, Doesn't need one now, Can't reach them) on the customer header and in the Overview, with the last-contacted date set automatically. The Overview overdue list is now one row per client, with a Clients to call filter, an outreach tile, and a Want a calibration list. Clients that buy through an agent show the agent instead.
